description: Meta Threads API for publishing content, retrieving media, managing replies, and viewing user and post insights.
auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 protocol using short-lived and long-lived Threads user access tokens acquired via the Authorization Window.
credential_notes: Developers can create a Meta app for free on the Meta for Developers platform and select the Threads use case; advanced access for live users requires app review.
api_notes: Covers creating/publishing single, carousel, and text posts, managing and retrieving replies, deleting posts, and retrieving profile and media insights.
mcp_notes: No official MCP server published by Meta; community MCP servers may exist independently.
rationale: Publicly documented REST API with free self-serve developer accounts, but publishing to general users requires app review and publishing approval.

evidence.note: Describes OAuth 2.0 user access tokens, authorization windows, and short/long-lived tokens.
Explains creating a Meta app with the Threads use case and setting up app roles / testers.
Details endpoints, rate limits, publishing constraints, and media formats for the Threads API.
Outlines how to create and publish single and carousel posts via REST endpoints.
Outlines media and user insights metrics available via the API.
